title: Glass Panes to Blocks
description: Turn glass panes back into blocks!
body:
Turn all your glass panes back into blocks with this simple recipe!![8 glass panes turn into 3 glass blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce7fd3143904a5ffb0987cf47efff0797cf87f49.png)

It works for stained glass as well!

Made with [this tool](https://misode.github.io/recipe/)
